response.rationale: D1 is the most complete, integrating all key findings: acute interstitial pancreatitis (F07), pseudocyst with gastric outlet obstruction (F08), pancreatic ascites (F09), pancreaticopleural fistula (F10, F12), and predisposing factors (F02, F14). D2 omits the pancreatic duct anomaly and alcohol history, which are diagnostically relevant. D3 and D4 lack specific complications or predispositions. D5 speculates about recurrence without direct support. The margin between D1 and D2 is high because D1 uniquely includes the duct anomaly and alcohol use as contributory factors, supported by F14 and F02.
